admissionSummary.scope: Complete safe definition admission. One fresh session per batch; legacy admits ordered requests individually, DAG admits the same requests in one checked graph batch.
admissionSummary.timing: admission_ms includes session creation and real public admission; independent exact-result assertions are reported separately.
admissionSummary.limitations: Finite fixtures; no general speedup, inductive-admission, or exact allocation-count claim.

summary.scope: Separate warmed runs of the existing correctness-guarded public checker operation; fresh semantic caches per call.
limitations: Instrumented times are diagnostics, not ordinary A-B-B-A performance measurements.
Heap sizes are V8 statistical sampling estimates, not exact allocation counts.
Survivors cover newly sampled allocations still live after GC, not a census or dominator analysis of the existing heap.
CPU weights approximate sampled self time; generated_owner_hint is a nearby source declaration, not a parsed scope proof.
Memory snapshots include inspector and diagnostic overhead; heap/RSS deltas alone do not establish object-retention ownership.

profiles.scope: All phase profile bytes, sample counts, CPU node references/time deltas, and sampled heap totals independently verified. Large diagnostic frame lists remain in the source-bound artifact; no exact-allocation or ordinary-timing claim.
